thread.title: Frida Stretre Løbersli completes NCAA Championships for FIU swimming and diving
thread.title_full: Frida Stretre Løbersli completes NCAA Championships for FIU swimming and diving

author: v. j. morris
title: Frida Stretre Løbersli completes NCAA Championships for FIU swimming and diving
text:
Sophomore Frida Stretre Løbersli of the FIU swimming and diving team finished her competition at the NCAA Championships at the McAuley Aquatic Center on March 19.
Stretre Løbersli participated in the 100-yard breaststroke, placing 41st with a time of 1:00.62 in her only event. Her participation marks the fifteenth consecutive year that FIU has had a swimmer compete at the NCAA Championships, which is currently the longest active streak among all mid-major swimming and diving programs.
This appearance concludes a season in which Stretre Løbersli earned three medals at the 2026 American Conference Swimming and Diving Championships. She won silver in the 100-breaststroke, contributed to setting both an FIU and American Conference record in the 200-medley relay with a time of 1:36.24, and also earned silver as part of the 400-medley relay team.
The university noted that Baptist Health is serving as The Official Sports Medicine Provider for FIU Athletics during the 2025-26 swimming and diving season.
Fans can follow updates about FIU swimming and diving on X (@FIUSwimDive), Facebook (@FIUSwimmingandDiving), Instagram (@FIUSwimDive), or find general athletic news at @FIUSports on Facebook and @FIUAthletics on Twitter and Instagram.
